topics.title: What Is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization Explained 2027
topics.h1: What Is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization: Definition, Examples and Steps
topics.description: What is AEO? Answer engine optimization explained: a clear definition, real examples, how it differs from SEO and the steps to start in 2027.
faqs: What is AEO in simple words?
AEO, or answer engine optimization, is shaping your content so search engines, voice assistants and AI tools can lift a direct answer from your page and show it to the person asking.
Is AEO different from SEO?
AEO builds on SEO. SEO helps a page rank; AEO makes sure the page also contains short, clear answers that an engine can quote in a snippet, a voice reply or an AI summary.
How long does AEO take to work?
Small fixes, such as adding answer-first paragraphs and FAQs to pages that already rank, can show results within weeks. New topics usually take a few months, the same as SEO.

topics.title: AEO vs GEO: Key Differences Explained for 2027
topics.h1: AEO vs GEO: Are They the Same Thing?
topics.description: AEO vs GEO explained: what answer engine optimization and generative engine optimization each target, where they overlap and which to start with.
faqs: Are AEO and GEO the same thing?
No, but they overlap. AEO targets direct answers in snippets, voice and AI summaries, while GEO targets being named and cited inside generated answers from tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini.
Should I do AEO or GEO first?
Start with AEO on pages that already rank, because the fixes are quick and also help GEO. Then add GEO work such as brand mentions and entity consistency.
Do AEO and GEO replace SEO?
No. Both depend on pages that search engines can crawl, index and trust, so SEO remains the base for each of them.

topics.title: What Is AIO? Meaning, Types and AI Overviews 2027
topics.h1: What Is AIO? Meaning, Types and Where It Differs From AI Overviews
topics.description: What is AIO? The meaning of AI optimization, the different ways the term is used, and how it differs from Google AI Overviews, explained simply.
faqs: What does AIO stand for in marketing?
In search marketing, AIO usually means AI optimization: making a website easy for AI systems to crawl, read, trust and recommend. Some people also use AIO as shorthand for Google AI Overviews.
Is AIO the same as AI Overviews?
No. AI Overviews is a Google Search feature that shows an AI summary. AIO is the work you do so that AI features and assistants understand and cite your site.
What does AIO work include?
Typical AIO work covers crawler access, clean HTML, structured data, clear entity information, content quality checks and tracking how AI tools describe your brand.

topics.title: How to Do AEO: 7 Steps to Win AI Answers in 2027
topics.h1: How to Do Answer Engine Optimization in 7 Steps
topics.description: How to do AEO in 7 steps: pick questions, write answer-first sections, add FAQs and schema, fix technical basics and track where your answers appear.
faqs: What is the first step in AEO?
Start by listing the real questions your buyers ask, then check which of your pages already rank for them. Those pages are your fastest AEO wins.
Do I need special tools for AEO?
No. Google Search Console, the People Also Ask box and your own sales questions are enough to start. Paid tools help later with tracking at scale.
How do I know if AEO is working?
Watch for featured snippets, more impressions on question queries in Search Console, and your brand appearing in AI answers for your tracked questions.

topics.title: Answer-First Content: How to Write Text AI Quotes 2027
topics.h1: How to Write Answer-First Content That AI Quotes
topics.description: Answer-first content puts the direct answer in the first 40 to 60 words. Learn the structure, examples and editing rules that make AI tools quote you.
faqs: What is answer-first content?
Answer-first content opens each section with a short, complete answer to the question in its heading, then adds detail, examples and evidence below it.
How long should the first answer be?
Aim for 40 to 60 words. That is long enough to be complete and short enough for a snippet, a voice reply or an AI summary to quote.
Does answer-first content hurt time on page?
Usually not. Readers who get a clear answer early trust the page and often keep reading for the detail, examples and next steps.

topics.title: Question Research SEO: Find What Buyers Ask in 2027
topics.h1: How to Find the Questions Your Buyers Ask: PAA, Sales Calls and Reddit
topics.description: Question research for SEO: find what buyers really ask using People Also Ask, Search Console, sales calls, support tickets and Reddit, then map answers.
faqs: Where can I find the questions customers ask?
Use People Also Ask boxes, Search Console queries, sales and support notes, review sites and community threads on Reddit or Quora.
How many questions should one page answer?
One main question per page, plus three to eight close follow-up questions. Unrelated questions belong on their own pages.
Are question keywords worth targeting if volume is low?
Yes. Question searches often show high intent, feed AI answers and add up across many pages, even when each one has small volume.

topics.title: Featured Snippet Optimization: Formats That Win 2027
topics.h1: How to Win Featured Snippets: Paragraph, List and Table Formats
topics.description: Featured snippet optimization: how to win paragraph, list and table snippets, which pages to target first and the formatting mistakes to avoid.
faqs: What is a featured snippet?
A featured snippet is a highlighted answer that Google shows above or among the results, taken from one page and shown as a paragraph, list or table.
Do I need to rank first to win a featured snippet?
No. Google usually picks the snippet from pages on the first page of results, so a page in positions two to ten can still win it.
Can I stop Google from showing my snippet?
Yes. The nosnippet or max-snippet robots rules limit how much text Google shows, but they also limit your chance of appearing in the snippet.

topics.title: Comparison Content SEO: Pages and Tables AI Cites 2027
topics.h1: Comparison Content SEO: Pages and Tables That AI Cites
topics.description: Comparison content for SEO: a template for X vs Y pages and comparison tables that rank, help buyers decide and get cited in AI answers.
faqs: What is comparison content?
Comparison content helps a reader choose between options, such as two products, tools or approaches, using clear criteria, a table and an honest verdict.
Can I compare my product with competitors?
Yes, if you stay factual, date your information and say where a competitor is the better fit. Fair comparisons earn more trust and citations.
Why do AI tools cite comparison tables?
Tables give clean, structured facts that are easy to extract, so assistants often use them when a user asks which option to choose.

topics.title: FAQ Section SEO: 20 Examples and Best Practices 2027
topics.h1: FAQ Section Best Practices: 20 Examples
topics.description: FAQ section SEO best practices with 20 example questions by page type: how many FAQs to add, how to write answers and where to place the section.
faqs: How many questions should an FAQ section have?
Three to eight is a good range for most pages. Add more only when each question is real, distinct and useful to the reader.
Where should the FAQ section go on a page?
Place it near the end, after the main content and before the final call to action, so it answers leftover doubts.
Do FAQ sections still help SEO?
Yes. Even without FAQ rich results, clear questions and answers help pages match long-tail searches and give AI tools quotable answers.

topics.title: FAQ Schema: Does It Still Work? What Changed for 2027
topics.h1: Does FAQ Schema Still Work? What the Evidence Says
topics.description: Does FAQ schema still work? What Google changed for FAQ rich results, who still gets them, and why FAQPage markup can still be worth adding.
faqs: Does Google still show FAQ rich results?
Only for a small group of well-known, authoritative government and health websites. Since August 2023 most other sites no longer get FAQ rich results.
Should I remove FAQ schema from my site?
There is no need to remove valid markup. It does no harm, and other search engines and tools may still read it.
Is FAQ content still useful without the rich result?
Yes. Clear questions and answers still help readers, long-tail rankings and AI answers, which matter more than the rich result.

topics.title: Voice Search SEO: Conversational Query Guide for 2027
topics.h1: Voice Search SEO: A Guide to Conversational Queries
topics.description: Voice search SEO guide: how spoken queries differ, how to write conversational answers, and the local and technical steps that win voice results.
faqs: How is voice search different from typed search?
Voice queries are longer, more conversational and often phrased as full questions, and many have local intent such as near me searches.
Where do voice assistants get their answers?
Most use a search index, a business listing or a featured snippet, so the same pages that win snippets and local results tend to win voice answers.
Is voice search SEO only for local businesses?
No, but local businesses gain the most, because many voice searches ask for directions, opening hours or a nearby service.

topics.title: Google AI Overviews Optimization: Get Cited in 2027
topics.h1: How to Get Cited in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode
topics.description: Google AI Overviews optimization: what Google says about AI features, how pages get cited in AI Overviews and AI Mode, and the steps to improve your odds.
faqs: Is there special markup for AI Overviews?
No. Google says there are no extra requirements: a page must be indexed and eligible to show a snippet, and the usual SEO best practices apply.
Can I see AI Overviews traffic in Search Console?
Clicks and impressions from AI features are included in the Web search type of the Performance report, but they are not shown as a separate line.
Can I stop my content from appearing in AI Overviews?
You can limit it with nosnippet or max-snippet rules, but that also limits your normal snippets, so most sites leave them on.

topics.title: What Is GEO? Generative Engine Optimization Guide 2027
topics.h1: What Is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)? A Full Guide
topics.description: What is GEO? Generative engine optimization explained: how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity choose sources, and the work that gets your brand cited.
faqs: What is GEO in simple words?
GEO, or generative engine optimization, is the work that helps AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity find, trust and mention your brand in their answers.
Who needs GEO?
Any business whose buyers ask AI tools for recommendations, comparisons or explanations before they buy, which now includes most B2B and many local businesses.
How is GEO measured?
Track a fixed set of prompts and record how often your brand is mentioned or cited, how it is described, and which sources the answers use.

topics.title: GEO vs SEO: What Changes and What Doesn't in 2027
topics.h1: GEO vs SEO: What Changes and What Doesn't
topics.description: GEO vs SEO compared: goals, signals, content, measurement and budget. See what stays the same, what changes and how to run both together.
faqs: Is GEO replacing SEO?
No. Generative engines still lean on search indexes and trusted web pages, so strong SEO remains the base that GEO builds on.
What is the main difference between GEO and SEO?
SEO aims for rankings and clicks on a results page; GEO aims for mentions and citations inside AI-generated answers.
Can one team handle both SEO and GEO?
Yes. Most of the work, such as content, technical health and authority, serves both; GEO adds prompt tracking and off-site mention work.

topics.title: SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO Difference: Decision Table 2027
topics.h1: SEO vs AEO vs GEO vs AIO: A Decision Table by Business Type
topics.description: The SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO difference in one decision table: what each one targets and which mix suits local, ecommerce, B2B and service businesses.
faqs: What is the difference between SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO?
SEO wins rankings, AEO wins direct answers, GEO wins mentions in AI-generated answers and AIO makes the whole site easy for AI systems to read and trust.
Which one should a small business start with?
Start with SEO and local SEO, then add AEO to the pages that rank. GEO and AIO follow once the basics are in place.
Do I need four separate agencies?
No. The four overlap heavily, so one team with a single plan usually works better than four separate projects.

topics.title: How to Rank in ChatGPT Search: A Practical Guide 2027
topics.h1: How to Rank in ChatGPT Search
topics.description: How to rank in ChatGPT: how ChatGPT search finds and cites sources, the crawler to allow, and the content and brand steps that raise your visibility.
faqs: Can I pay to rank in ChatGPT?
No. There is no paid placement in ChatGPT answers. Visibility comes from being crawlable, relevant and widely trusted across the web.
Which crawler does ChatGPT search use?
OpenAI lists OAI-SearchBot as the crawler for ChatGPT search results. Blocking it in robots.txt can keep your pages out of those answers.
How do I check if ChatGPT mentions my brand?
Run a fixed set of buyer questions in ChatGPT each month, note whether your brand appears and which sources it cites, and compare over time.

topics.title: Get Cited by Perplexity, Gemini and Claude in 2027
topics.h1: How to Earn Recommendations From Perplexity, Gemini and Claude
topics.description: How to get cited by Perplexity, Gemini and Claude: how each assistant picks sources, the crawlers to allow and the content that earns recommendations.
faqs: Why does Perplexity show citations?
Perplexity searches the web for each question and lists its sources, so pages that answer clearly and load easily for crawlers have a good chance of being cited.
Does Gemini use Google Search rankings?
Gemini can ground answers in Google Search, so pages that rank and show clear answers in Google are well placed to appear in Gemini.
Do I need different content for each assistant?
No. The same clear, factual, well-structured pages work across assistants. The differences are mainly in crawlers and source mix.

topics.title: AI Prompt Set: Build a 30-Prompt Tracking List 2027
topics.h1: How to Build a 30-Prompt Tracking Set and Freeze It
topics.description: Build an AI prompt set for tracking: 30 buyer prompts across five intent types, how to freeze them, and how to record results each month.
faqs: Why freeze the prompt set?
If the prompts change every month, you cannot tell whether visibility moved because of your work or because you asked different questions.
Why 30 prompts?
Thirty is enough to cover your main topics and intents, yet small enough to check by hand or with a simple tool every month.
How often should I re-run the prompts?
Monthly is a good rhythm. AI answers vary from run to run, so run each prompt more than once and record the share of runs that mention you.

topics.title: Brand Mentions in LLM Answers: How to Grow Them 2027
topics.h1: How to Increase Brand Mentions in AI Answers
topics.description: Brand mentions in LLM answers: why AI tools name some brands and not others, and seven ways to earn more mentions and better descriptions.
faqs: Do unlinked brand mentions help in AI answers?
Yes. Language models learn from text, so consistent mentions of your brand with your topic can help even when there is no link.
How long does it take to change how AI describes my brand?
Answers that search the live web can change within weeks. Descriptions learned during model training change more slowly, often over several months.
What if an AI tool describes my brand wrongly?
Fix the facts at the source: your website, business profiles and major listings. Then publish clear pages that state the correct details.

topics.title: Reddit AI Citations: Why Reddit and YouTube Win 2027
topics.h1: Why Reddit, YouTube and LinkedIn Dominate AI Citations and What to Do
topics.description: Reddit AI citations explained: why AI answers often cite Reddit, YouTube and LinkedIn, and how a business can take part honestly on each platform.
faqs: Why do AI tools cite Reddit so often?
Reddit holds a huge amount of first-hand experience and discussion on almost every topic, and AI tools value real user opinions for review and comparison questions.
Should my business post on Reddit for AI visibility?
Only as a genuine member: answer questions, disclose who you are and follow each community's rules. Promotional posts get removed and hurt trust.
Which platform should a B2B company focus on?
LinkedIn and YouTube usually fit B2B best: expert posts and explainer videos are easy to cite and build the same expertise buyers look for.

topics.title: Original Data SEO: Research That Earns Citations 2027
topics.h1: Original Research That Earns Citations: A Playbook
topics.description: Original data SEO playbook: how to run small surveys and data studies, publish them so others cite you, and turn findings into AI-quotable facts.
faqs: Do I need a big budget for original research?
No. A survey of 100 customers, your own anonymised platform data or a careful price comparison can all produce useful, citable findings.
How do I get others to cite my research?
Publish clear headline findings, a simple method section and shareable charts, then send the findings to journalists and creators who cover the topic.
How often should I publish new data?
Once or twice a year is enough for most businesses. Updating a strong study each year often works better than starting new ones.

topics.title: Entity SEO: Build Your Knowledge Graph Footprint 2027
topics.h1: Entity SEO: Build Your Knowledge Graph Footprint
topics.description: Entity SEO explained: how search engines and AI tools understand brands as entities, and the steps to build a consistent knowledge graph footprint.
faqs: What is an entity in SEO?
An entity is a distinct thing that search engines can identify, such as a person, company, product or place, with facts and links to other entities.
How do I get a Knowledge Panel?
There is no form to request one. Consistent facts across your site, business profiles, directories and trusted sources make it more likely over time.
Does entity SEO help in AI answers?
Yes. AI tools describe brands more accurately when the same clear facts appear across many trusted sources.

topics.title: Zero Click Search: Measure Success Without Clicks 2027
topics.h1: Zero-Click Search: How to Measure Success Without Clicks
topics.description: Zero click search explained: why more searches end without a click, which metrics still show value, and how to report success to your team.
faqs: What is a zero-click search?
A zero-click search is one where the person gets their answer on the results page, in a snippet, map pack or AI answer, and does not click any result.
Is zero-click search bad for businesses?
Not always. Being the answer builds awareness and trust, and it often leads to later branded searches, calls or visits.
Which metrics show value without clicks?
Impressions, snippet and AI answer presence, branded search growth, calls and direction requests from your business profile, and assisted conversions.

topics.title: AI Search Myths: 9 Beliefs to Drop in 2027
topics.h1: 9 AI Search Myths and What the Evidence Shows
topics.description: Nine common AI search myths, from SEO is dead to llms.txt guarantees citations, checked against what search engines and AI companies have said.
faqs: Is SEO dead because of AI search?
No. AI search tools still rely on crawled, indexed and trusted web pages, so SEO remains the base for AI visibility.
Do I need to write content just for AI?
No. Content that is clear, accurate and helpful for people is the same content AI tools prefer to quote.
Can a tool guarantee AI citations?
No. No one controls how AI systems choose sources, so treat any guarantee of citations or rankings as a warning sign.

topics.title: AI Competitor Analysis: Citation Gap Template 2027
topics.h1: AI Competitor Analysis: A Citation Gap Template
topics.description: AI competitor analysis template: find which competitors AI answers mention, which sources they cite and the citation gaps you can close first.
faqs: What is a citation gap?
A citation gap is a source or a prompt where AI answers mention or cite your competitors but not you.
How many competitors should I track?
Three to five is enough: your closest direct rivals plus one or two brands that AI tools mention often in your topic.
How do I close a citation gap?
Improve or create the page that answers the prompt, then earn a place in the sources the answers already cite, such as lists, reviews and directories.

topics.title: AI Crawlers in robots.txt: Which Bots to Allow 2027
topics.h1: Which AI Crawlers to Allow: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended
topics.description: AI crawlers in robots.txt: what GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended do, and a sample policy for your site.
faqs: Does blocking GPTBot remove me from ChatGPT search?
No. OpenAI uses GPTBot for model training and OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT search, so you can block one and allow the other.
Does Google-Extended affect Google Search rankings?
No. Google-Extended only controls whether content is used for Gemini models and grounding; it does not change Google Search crawling or ranking.
Do all AI crawlers obey robots.txt?
The major companies say their crawlers follow robots.txt, but robots.txt is a request, not a lock, so use firewall rules for bots that ignore it.

topics.title: llms.txt: Does It Help and How to Create One 2027
topics.h1: llms.txt: Does It Help? How to Create One
topics.description: What llms.txt is, what it can and cannot do for AI visibility, and how to create a simple llms.txt file for your website in a few minutes.
faqs: Does Google use llms.txt?
Google has not said it uses llms.txt for Search or AI Overviews, so do not expect ranking gains from it.
Is llms.txt the same as robots.txt?
No. robots.txt tells crawlers what they may fetch; llms.txt is a proposed guide that points language models to your most useful pages.
Is it worth creating an llms.txt file?
It takes little time and does no harm, so it can be worth adding, but treat it as a small extra and not as a strategy.

topics.title: Agentic SEO: Optimizing for AI Agents in 2027
topics.h1: Agentic SEO: Optimizing for AI Agents and the Accessibility Tree
topics.description: Agentic SEO explained: how AI agents read and use websites through the accessibility tree, and how to make forms, buttons and content agent-ready.
faqs: What is agentic SEO?
Agentic SEO is making your website easy for AI agents to understand and use, so they can find information, compare options and complete tasks for a user.
What is the accessibility tree?
It is the structured view of a page that browsers build for assistive technology, with roles, names and states, and many AI agents read it too.
Is agentic SEO different from accessibility work?
They overlap heavily. Clear labels, real buttons and logical structure help screen reader users and AI agents in the same way.

topics.title: Markdown for AI: Text-Only Page Versions for LLMs 2027
topics.h1: Markdown and Text-Only Versions of Pages for LLMs
topics.description: Markdown for AI: when text-only or Markdown versions of pages help language models, how to publish them safely and what to avoid.
faqs: Do I need Markdown versions of my pages?
Most sites do not. Clean, well-structured HTML already works well. Markdown copies mainly help documentation sites and developer tools.
Can Markdown copies cause duplicate content?
They can if search engines index them. Keep the HTML page as the canonical version and avoid linking the copies in normal navigation.
Should the Markdown copy differ from the page?
No. It should say the same thing as the HTML page. Showing different content to bots than to people is a spam risk.

topics.title: JavaScript SEO for AI: Do Bots See Your Content? 2027
topics.h1: Does JavaScript Hide Your Content From AI Bots?
topics.description: JavaScript SEO for AI: why many AI crawlers do not run JavaScript, how to test what they see and the rendering fixes that keep content visible.
faqs: Do AI crawlers run JavaScript?
Many AI crawlers fetch only the raw HTML and do not run JavaScript, so content that appears only after scripts run may be invisible to them.
How can I check what an AI bot sees?
View the page source or fetch the page with a tool such as curl. If the main text is missing from the raw HTML, many AI bots will miss it too.
What is the best fix for JavaScript-heavy sites?
Server-side rendering or static generation, so the main content and links are in the HTML the server sends.

topics.title: AI Content Quality: Policy and Scaled Content Review 2027
topics.h1: AI-Generated Content Policy and Scaled-Content Abuse Review
topics.description: AI content quality policy: what Google's scaled content abuse rule means, a simple AI content policy template and a review checklist for every page.
faqs: Does Google penalise AI-generated content?
Google does not ban AI content. It targets content made at scale mainly to manipulate rankings, however it was produced.
What is scaled content abuse?
It is Google's spam policy against producing many pages that add little value, often by automation, mainly to rank in search.
Who should review AI-assisted content?
A person who knows the subject should check facts, add real experience and approve each page before it goes live.

topics.title: Content Provenance: C2PA, Authors and Sources in 2027
topics.h1: Content Provenance and Source Transparency: C2PA and Author Pages
topics.description: Content provenance explained: C2PA content credentials, author pages, source lists and edit histories that show readers and AI tools who made your content.
faqs: What is C2PA?
C2PA is an open standard from the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity that attaches signed information about how a file was created and edited.
Do author pages help SEO?
They help readers and search engines judge expertise and trust, which supports rankings and AI citations even though they are not a direct ranking switch.
Should I label AI-assisted content?
Being open about how content was made builds trust. A short note on how you use AI and who reviews the content is a good start.

topics.title: Programmatic SEO in the AI Era: What Works in 2027
topics.h1: Programmatic SEO in the AI Era: What Still Works
topics.description: Programmatic SEO in the AI era: when template-driven pages still work, how to add unique value to each page and how to avoid scaled content problems.
faqs: Is programmatic SEO still allowed?
Yes, when each page is genuinely useful. Pages that only swap a keyword into the same text risk falling under Google's scaled content abuse policy.
What makes a programmatic page useful?
Unique data, local or specific details, real examples and content that answers the search better than a general page would.
How many programmatic pages should I launch at once?
Start with a small batch, check indexing and engagement, and expand only when those pages perform.

topics.title: AI Search Tracking Tools Compared: Best Picks 2027
topics.h1: Best AI Search Visibility Tracking Tools Compared
topics.description: AI search tracking tools compared: what these tools measure, the features that matter, well-known options and how to choose one for your budget.
faqs: What does an AI search tracking tool do?
It runs a set of prompts in AI assistants on a schedule and reports how often your brand is mentioned or cited, and next to which competitors.
Are AI tracking tools accurate?
They are useful for trends, not exact counts. AI answers vary between runs, locations and accounts, so look at averages over time.
Can I track AI visibility without a paid tool?
Yes. A fixed prompt list, a spreadsheet and a monthly manual check work well for small businesses.

topics.title: AI Search ROI: How to Prove Value to Leadership 2027
topics.h1: How to Prove the ROI of AI Search to Leadership
topics.description: AI search ROI: the metrics leadership cares about, how to connect AI visibility to leads and revenue, and a simple monthly report format.
faqs: Can you measure ROI from AI search?
Partly. You can measure AI referral visits and their conversions directly, and track visibility and branded search as leading signals.
What is a good first AI search KPI?
Share of tracked prompts where your brand is mentioned, reported each month next to AI referral visits and leads.
How long before AI search shows ROI?
Expect leading signals within a few months and clearer revenue links after six to twelve months, much like SEO.

topics.title: AI Traffic in GA4: Track ChatGPT and AI Referrals 2027
topics.h1: Tracking AI Referral Traffic in GA4
topics.description: Track AI traffic in GA4: a step-by-step setup for a custom channel group and report that shows visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot.
faqs: Does GA4 show ChatGPT traffic?
Yes, when the visit arrives with a referrer or a utm_source such as chatgpt.com. Grouping these sources into one channel makes them easy to see.
Why is some AI traffic missing in GA4?
Some apps and browsers strip the referrer, so those visits land in Direct. Your AI numbers are therefore a minimum, not a full count.
Can I apply the AI channel to past data?
Custom channel groups in GA4 apply to historical data as well, so you can see past AI visits once the group is set up.

topics.title: GSC AI Overviews: Search Console for AEO Reports 2027
topics.h1: Using Search Console for AEO and GEO Reporting
topics.description: Use GSC for AI Overviews, AEO and GEO reporting: what Search Console shows about AI features, useful filters and a simple monthly report.
faqs: Does Search Console show AI Overviews separately?
No. Clicks and impressions from AI Overviews and AI Mode are included in the Web search type, without a separate filter.
How can I find question queries in Search Console?
Use a query filter with a regular expression such as what, how, why, which or can at the start of the query.
What should a monthly AEO report include?
Question query impressions and clicks, pages with featured snippets, average position for target questions and notes on AI answer checks.

topics.title: AI Visibility Dashboard: Monthly Metrics to Report 2027
topics.h1: AI Visibility Dashboard: Metrics to Report Monthly
topics.description: An AI visibility dashboard template: the monthly metrics to report for SEO, AEO and GEO, where each number comes from and how to lay it out.
faqs: What should an AI visibility dashboard show?
Prompt mention rate, citation share, AI referral visits and leads, question query performance in Search Console and branded search trends.
Which tool should I build the dashboard in?
Looker Studio works well because it connects to GA4 and Search Console for free; prompt results can come from a shared sheet.
How many metrics should the dashboard have?
Keep the first page to five to eight numbers that leadership understands, with detail on later pages.

topics.title: Topical Authority: A Complete Topic Cluster Guide 2027
topics.h1: Topical Authority: A Complete Guide to Topic Clusters
topics.description: Topical authority explained: how topic clusters work, how to plan pillar and cluster pages, link them together and measure your progress.
faqs: What is topical authority?
Topical authority is how well search engines trust a site on a subject, built by covering that subject in depth with well-linked, helpful pages.
How many articles do I need for topical authority?
There is no fixed number. Cover the main questions in your topic well; for many small businesses that is 10 to 30 focused pages.
Does topical authority help AI visibility?
Yes. Sites that cover a topic in depth and consistently are more likely to be used as sources by AI answers on that topic.

topics.title: SEO Checklist: Webpage Checks With Scoring for 2027
topics.h1: Webpage SEO Checklist With Scoring
topics.description: A webpage SEO checklist with a simple scoring method: technical, on-page, content, links and AI readiness checks grouped so you can fix the biggest gaps first.
faqs: How do I score a page with an SEO checklist?
Give each check a pass, warn or fail, weight the groups by impact, and add up the points so you can compare pages and track progress.
How often should I run an SEO checklist?
Run it before publishing each page and repeat it on key pages every quarter or after major site changes.
Is a perfect checklist score necessary?
No. A checklist finds problems; rankings depend on usefulness and authority too, so fix the high-impact issues first.

topics.title: EEAT Audit Checklist: Show Experience and Trust 2027
topics.h1: EEAT Audit Checklist: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and Trust
topics.description: An EEAT audit checklist: how to show experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trust on your pages, author profiles and across the web.
faqs: Is EEAT a ranking factor?
Not a single factor. EEAT is a framework from Google's quality rater guidelines that describes what helpful, trustworthy content looks like, and many ranking signals reflect it.
What does the extra E in EEAT stand for?
Experience: first-hand knowledge of the topic, such as having used the product or done the work yourself.
Which part of EEAT matters most?
Trust. Google describes it as the most important part, supported by experience, expertise and authoritativeness.

topics.title: Content Refresh: When and How to Update Pages 2027
topics.h1: Content Refresh: When and How to Update
topics.description: Content refresh guide: the signs a page needs updating, how to choose pages to refresh first and a step-by-step process that keeps rankings safe.
faqs: How often should I refresh content?
Review key pages every 6 to 12 months, and sooner when facts, prices or search results change.
Should I change the publish date when I refresh?
Update the modified date when you make real changes. Changing dates without changing content is misleading and does not help.
Should I change the URL when updating a post?
No. Keep the same URL so the page keeps its links and history; change the content, title and headings instead.

topics.title: Keyword Cannibalization: How to Find and Fix It 2027
topics.h1: Fixing Keyword Cannibalization
topics.description: Keyword cannibalization explained: how to find pages competing for the same search, when it is a real problem and five ways to fix it.
faqs: What is keyword cannibalization?
It happens when two or more of your pages target the same search intent, so they compete with each other and none ranks as well as one strong page would.
Is it always a problem when two pages rank for one keyword?
No. If they serve different intents or both rank well, it may be fine. It is a problem when rankings swap back and forth or both stay low.
What is the most common fix?
Merge the weaker page into the stronger one, keep the best content and add a permanent redirect from the old URL.

topics.title: Internal Linking Strategy for Topic Clusters 2027
topics.h1: Internal Linking Strategy for Topic Clusters
topics.description: An internal linking strategy for topic clusters: how to link pillar and cluster pages, write good anchor text and find pages that need more links.
faqs: How many internal links should a page have?
There is no fixed number. Link wherever it helps the reader; most articles have at least three to five relevant internal links.
Should internal links use exact keywords as anchor text?
Use descriptive anchors that tell the reader what they will find. Exact keywords are fine sometimes, but vary them naturally.
What is an orphan page?
A page with no internal links pointing to it. Search engines and visitors struggle to find it, so link it from related pages.

topics.title: Image SEO and Video SEO for Search and AI in 2027
topics.h1: Image and Video SEO for Search and AI
topics.description: Image SEO and video SEO guide: file names, alt text, formats, sizes, structured data and the steps that help images and videos show in search and AI.
faqs: What is good alt text?
Alt text that describes the image in a short phrase, in the context of the page, without stuffing keywords.
Which image format is best for SEO?
WebP or AVIF for photos and SVG for simple graphics usually give the best quality for the smallest file size.
How do I get my videos into Google Search?
Host the video on a page about it, add VideoObject structured data, include a thumbnail and let Google crawl the video file or embed.

topics.title: Title Tag and Meta Description Formulas for 2027
topics.h1: Title Tag and Meta Description Formulas
topics.description: Title tag and meta description formulas that work: length, structure, keyword placement and examples for service, blog, product and local pages.
faqs: How long should a title tag be?
Around 50 to 60 characters usually shows in full on desktop. Put the main keyword and the key benefit near the start.
Does Google always use my title tag?
No. Google may rewrite titles that are too long, vague or keyword-stuffed, so clear and accurate titles are more likely to be kept.
Do meta descriptions affect rankings?
Not directly, but a clear description can raise click-through rate, and Google sometimes shows it as the snippet.

topics.title: Readability SEO: Flesch, Passive Voice and Length 2027
topics.h1: Readability Metrics for SEO: Flesch, Passive Voice and Sentence Length
topics.description: Readability SEO: what the Flesch score, passive voice and sentence length tell you, sensible targets and how to edit content that people finish.
faqs: Is readability a Google ranking factor?
Not directly. Clear writing helps readers understand and stay, and those outcomes support rankings and AI answers.
What is a good Flesch reading ease score?
For most business content, a score of 50 to 70 is a good target. Technical topics can be lower if the audience expects it.
How much passive voice is acceptable?
Keeping passive sentences under about 10 percent is a useful guide. Use passive voice only when the actor does not matter.

topics.title: Technical SEO Checklist for AI Search in 2027
topics.h1: Technical SEO Checklist for AI Search
topics.description: A technical SEO checklist for AI search: crawling, indexing, rendering, speed, structured data, security and AI crawler access in one list.
faqs: What is the most important technical SEO check?
Make sure your important pages can be crawled and indexed. Without that, no other improvement can help them appear.
Is technical SEO different for AI search?
The basics are the same, but AI crawlers often skip JavaScript and have their own user agents, so raw HTML and robots rules matter more.
How often should I run a technical SEO audit?
Run a full audit once or twice a year and a quick check after every redesign, migration or major release.

topics.title: Schema Markup Guide: Organization, Person, Article 2027
topics.h1: Schema Markup Guide: Organization, Person, Article and FAQ
topics.description: Schema markup guide: how to add Organization, Person, Article and FAQ structured data with JSON-LD, test it and avoid common mistakes.
faqs: What is schema markup?
Schema markup is code, usually JSON-LD, that describes a page's content in a standard vocabulary so search engines and tools can understand it.
Does schema markup improve rankings?
Not directly, but it makes pages eligible for rich results and helps search engines and AI tools understand entities and facts.
Which schema should every business site have?
Organization on the home page, Article on blog posts, Person for authors and BreadcrumbList for navigation are a solid base.

topics.title: Core Web Vitals Fix Guide: LCP, INP and CLS 2027
topics.h1: Core Web Vitals Fix Guide: LCP, INP and CLS
topics.description: Core Web Vitals fix guide: the LCP, INP and CLS thresholds, how to find the cause of a poor score and the fixes that work most often.
faqs: What are good Core Web Vitals scores?
LCP within 2.5 seconds, INP within 200 milliseconds and CLS below 0.1, measured at the 75th percentile of real visits.
What replaced FID in Core Web Vitals?
Interaction to Next Paint, or INP, replaced First Input Delay as a Core Web Vital in March 2024.
Do Core Web Vitals affect rankings much?
They are part of page experience signals. They rarely beat relevance, but they can make the difference between similar pages.

topics.title: Accessibility SEO: ARIA and Keyboard Checklist 2027
topics.h1: Accessibility as SEO: An ARIA and Keyboard Checklist
topics.description: Accessibility SEO checklist: headings, alt text, labels, ARIA, keyboard use and contrast, and how each one also helps search engines and AI agents.
faqs: Is accessibility a ranking factor?
Not directly, but many accessibility basics, such as headings, alt text and clear links, help search engines understand pages too.
When should I use ARIA?
Only when native HTML cannot do the job. A real button or link is better than a div with ARIA roles added.
Which standard should I follow?
WCAG 2.2 at level AA is the common target for business websites.

topics.title: Security Headers SEO: CSP, HSTS and Trust in 2027
topics.h1: Security Headers and SEO Trust: CSP, HSTS and COOP
topics.description: Security headers and SEO: what CSP, HSTS, COOP and other headers do, how they support trust and how to add them without breaking your site.
faqs: Do security headers improve rankings?
Not directly. HTTPS is a light signal, and headers protect visitors, which supports the trust that rankings and conversions depend on.
Can a Content Security Policy break my site?
Yes, a strict policy can block scripts or styles. Start in report-only mode and fix the reports before you enforce it.
How do I check my security headers?
Open your browser's developer tools and look at the response headers, or use a free header checking service.

topics.title: Browser Compatibility and Deprecated API Audit 2027
topics.h1: Browser Compatibility and Deprecated API Audit
topics.description: A browser compatibility audit: how to test your site across browsers and devices, find deprecated APIs and fix issues that hurt users and SEO.
faqs: Which browsers should I test?
Test the browsers your visitors use, which you can see in GA4. For most sites that means Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox and Samsung Internet on mobile.
How do I find deprecated APIs on my site?
Run Lighthouse in Chrome; its best practices section lists deprecated APIs, and the browser console shows warnings too.
Does browser compatibility affect SEO?
Indirectly. Pages that break for some visitors lose engagement and conversions, and broken rendering can hide content from crawlers.

topics.title: AEO Services: What's Included and Pricing in 2027
topics.h1: AEO Services: What's Included and Pricing
topics.description: AEO services explained: what a good answer engine optimization package includes, how pricing works, what results to expect and questions to ask.
faqs: What do AEO services include?
Question research, answer-first rewrites of key pages, FAQ sections and structured data, technical fixes and monthly tracking of snippets and AI answers.
How much do AEO services cost?
Most providers bundle AEO into a monthly SEO plan. At Openink Hub, AI SEO plans start from 10,000 rupees a month, with the scope set after an audit.
How fast do AEO services show results?
Pages that already rank can win snippets within weeks; new topics usually take three to six months.

topics.title: GEO Agency: How to Choose and Questions to Ask 2027
topics.h1: GEO Agency: How to Choose and the Questions to Ask
topics.description: How to choose a GEO agency: what generative engine optimization work should include, 12 questions to ask and the red flags to avoid.
faqs: What does a GEO agency do?
It improves how AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity find, describe and cite your brand, through content, entity work, mentions and tracking.
Can a GEO agency guarantee AI citations?
No. No one controls AI answers. A good agency promises a clear process and honest tracking, not guaranteed placements.
Should my GEO agency also do SEO?
Ideally yes. GEO depends on crawlable, trusted pages, so an agency that handles both can plan the work as one.

topics.title: AI SEO Audit: What It Checks and What You Get 2027
topics.h1: AI SEO Audit: What It Checks and What You Get
topics.description: An AI SEO audit checks how Google and AI assistants see your site. Learn what it covers, what the report includes and how to act on it.
faqs: What is an AI SEO audit?
It is an SEO audit that also checks how answer engines and AI assistants read, describe and cite your site, not only how it ranks in Google.
How long does an AI SEO audit take?
A small business site usually takes a few days; large sites with many templates take longer.
What should I do after the audit?
Fix the high-impact issues first, usually crawl access, key page content and entity details, then work through the rest in order.

topics.title: AI Visibility Checker: Test Your Brand in AI 2027
topics.h1: AI Visibility Checker: How to Test Your Brand in AI Answers
topics.description: Use this AI visibility checker method to test how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity see your brand, score the results and know what to fix first.
faqs: How can I check my brand's AI visibility for free?
Ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity ten buyer questions about your category, note whether they mention you and how they describe you, and repeat monthly.
Why do results differ between AI tools?
Each assistant uses different search sources, models and settings, so the same question can name different brands in each tool.
What is a good AI visibility score?
There is no universal benchmark. Compare yourself with your closest competitors on the same prompts and track your trend over time.
